data.Job_Description: Location: Remote Engagement: Full-Time Good security is invisible until it isn't — and great architects make sure it never has to be. At BISTEC Global, our family of engineers designs and governs security architecture for enterprise clients across Australia, the UK, and beyond. We're looking for a security architect who takes real pride in secure-by-design thinking and the people who depend on it every day. Key Responsibilities: Architect — define and maintain security reference architectures across cloud and on-premises environments. Advise — act as a trusted security advisor to development, delivery, and platform teams throughout the solution lifecycle. Govern — review and approve solution designs against Zero Trust, least privilege, and defence-in-depth principles. Elevate — drive measurable improvements in Microsoft Secure Score, Defender, and Sentinel maturity. What We're Looking For : 7+ years in information security, with strong experience in security architecture roles. Has hands-on experience with Azure and the Microsoft security suite, including Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Intune, and Lighthouse. Solid grounding in Zero Trust, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF 2.0. Confident, clear communication — comfortable advising senior stakeholders. Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, AZ-500, or AZ-305 are a valued bonus. #LI-DNI

Contract Type: 1 Year (with potential for extension) Location: Remote Engagement: Full-Time What You'll Do Design, build and ship business apps with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Power BI. Craft conversational agents in Copilot Studio — topics, actions, knowledge sources and secure connectors. Develop and administer SharePoint Online sites, lists, libraries and JSON-formatted solutions. Integrate across Microsoft 365, Teams, Dataverse and third-party systems via standard and custom connectors. Apply solid ALM — environments, solution packaging, versioning and clean releases. Run requirement workshops, demos and training, translating business needs into scalable solutions. What You'll Bring 3–4 years hands-on with Microsoft 365, Power Platform or Modern Workplace technologies. Strong practical skills across Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and SharePoint Online. Experience with Copilot / Copilot Studio and building generative-AI knowledge sources. Working knowledge of Power Fx, SharePoint JSON, REST APIs and Microsoft Graph. Confidence troubleshooting access, security, workflow and integration issues. Clear communicator who can work independently and within a multidisciplinary team. Bonus Points SPFx, JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML & CSS · custom connectors, plugins & API extensions. Power Platform governance, DLP policies & Center of Excellence · Azure DevOps / GitHub, CI-CD. Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access & Purview basics · consulting or client-facing experience. Microsoft certifications in Power Platform, M365, SharePoint, Azure or Copilot. #LI-DNI

Fully Remote Full-Time 6-Month Contract (Renewable) Join our team as a CRM Developer, building, customising and supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Platform solutions across multiple client environments. What You'll Do Develop, customise and maintain Dynamics 365 CRM / Customer Engagement applications across Sales, Customer Service, Field Service and Customer Insights. Design and troubleshoot C# plugins, custom workflows and server-side logic, plus JavaScript client-side customisations. Configure Dataverse tables, relationships, forms, views, business rules and security roles. Build and troubleshoot Power Automate flows, Power Pages portals and Power Apps, with integrations via APIs and connectors. Diagnose production incidents, perform root cause analysis and deliver sustainable fixes within agreed service levels. Manage solutions across Development, Test/UAT and Production, including managed and unmanaged deployments. Work with functional consultants and client stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess feasibility and provide realistic estimates. Maintain technical documentation, perform unit testing and support UAT while following coding and security standards. What You'll Bring Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or a related discipline. Preferably 4–6 years of relevant experience, including significant hands-on Dynamics 365 CRM development. Strong C# and .NET skills, particularly Dynamics 365 plugins and server-side customisations. Strong JavaScript skills for Dynamics 365 client-side customisations. Experience with Microsoft Dataverse, including data models, relationships and security. Practical experience developing and troubleshooting Power Automate flows. Experience with solution management and deployment across multiple environments, including managed and unmanaged solutions. Experience with REST APIs, third-party integrations and supporting CRM applications in production. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, clear English communication and a proactive, client-focused mindset. Desirable Power Pages and Power Apps (model-driven and canvas) experience. Power BI and SSRS reporting experience. Familiarity with DocumentsCorePack, ClickDimensions and payment integrations. Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or similar platforms; Power Platform ALM and deployment pipelines. Copilot Studio and AI agents knowledge; Microsoft certifications such as PL-400. Candidates must be based in Sri Lanka.

Remote Full-Time Join our engineering team to design, build and run modern web applications using React on the front end, Ruby on the back end and Google Cloud Platform for infrastructure — turning business needs into reliable, scalable products. What You'll Do Build responsive, high-quality user interfaces with React. Develop and maintain back-end services, APIs and business logic in Ruby. Design, deploy and operate cloud-based solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Design RESTful APIs and integrate front-end, back-end and third-party services. Write clean, tested, maintainable code and take part in code reviews. Troubleshoot and resolve performance, reliability and security issues across the stack. Collaborate with product, design and QA teams, and support the growth of fellow engineers. What You'll Bring 5+ years of professional software development experience. Strong hands-on experience with React, including component design and state management. Strong hands-on experience with Ruby for back-end development. Practical experience building and deploying applications on Google Cloud Platform. Solid understanding of REST APIs, databases and web application architecture. Experience with version control, automated testing and CI/CD practices. Clear communication and a collaborative, problem-solving mindset. Nice to Have Experience with Ruby on Rails and TypeScript. Containers and managed services on GCP, such as Docker, GKE or Cloud Run. Infrastructure as code, such as Terraform. Google Cloud certifications. Candidates must be based in Sri Lanka.

Remote Full-Time 1-Year Contract (Renewable) Join our team as a Senior QA Engineer, owning test strategy and execution across functional, integration and regression testing combining manual and automated testing to protect quality across the SDLC. This is a client-facing role where strong communication is essential. What You'll Do Analyse and review business and technical requirements for clarity and completeness. Design and document test strategies, plans, scenarios and cases aligned with functional and non-functional requirements. Facilitate test planning and review sessions with cross-functional teams. Create, maintain and execute manual and automated tests; capture results and report defects following defect management protocols. Perform front-end and back-end testing to validate data consistency and system behaviour. Perform white-box testing to evaluate internal structures, logic and code behaviour. Collaborate with stakeholders, business analysts and developers to keep testing aligned with project requirements. Support UAT planning and execution with business users, and provide clear, timely updates on testing progress and quality risks. Recommend process improvements and promote QA best practices across teams. What You'll Bring University degree or college diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or a related discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance, with expertise in functional, integration and regression testing. Solid hands-on experience in automation testing and API testing. Excellent communication skills are essential — this is a client-facing role, so you will present test progress, risks and results directly to clients and stakeholders. Minimum 3 years developing and maintaining test automation scripts, including CI/CD integration, automation data management and integrating automation results into overall test reporting. Proficient in QA methodologies and SDLC processes across Agile, Waterfall or Hybrid environments. A Plus to Have Experience with cloud platforms, application modernisation or data migration. Background in performance, security or vulnerability testing. Skills in delivering system demos to stakeholders. Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills. Self-motivated, with the ability to adapt quickly and manage multiple priorities. Demonstrated commitment to the ethical use of AI and active adoption of digital tools and strategies to drive innovation, efficiency and quality across the SDLC.
